scope: local source/real-Chromium reproduction only; NOT hosted acceptance. Hosted Management outcome and aggregate remain FAIL for the exact 82ff run.
root_cause: The continueRequest rejection handler captured closed/detached/canceled booleans before its 25ms wait, so lifecycle events (loadingFailed canceled, new Document request, frameNavigated/detach) queued behind the CDP command rejection were never seen; a genuinely cancelled intercepted request was classified as a live Invalid InterceptionId.
fix: scripts/lib/pinned-browser-bff-bearer.mjs: for Invalid InterceptionId only, take a Chromium-clock timestamp (Performance.getMetrics) right after the rejection, then poll (10ms, 1000ms bound) for ordered facts: Network.loadingFailed canceled with Chromium timestamp <= the rejection, preceded (arrival order) by a navigation: document replacement, Page.navigatedWithinDocument, or frame detach. Closure alone is never proof, and cancellation/navigation/teardown after the rejection cannot excuse a live invalid id.
